newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SMH Q1 profits, sales above last year.
newsitem.headline: SMH Q1 profits, sales above last year.

text.p: Nicolas Hayek, chairman and chief executive of Swiss watchmaker Ste Suisse Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA (SMH) said profits and sales in the first quarter of 1997 were above the first quarter of 1996.
"The first three months were very good for us. Practically all our brands have sold in very good volumes," Hayek told a news conference about the Omega brand.
He did not provide any first quarter figures.
"We have done significantly more of each brand than last year. It (the first quarter) was very promising as far as sales is concerned, and as far as profits, it was also better," Hayek said.
